scope: Incremental chat widget implementation, not complete interactive chat: a default-off device-local option displays up to five recent loaded messages from the currently viewed text channel, without fetching or marking history read.

Projection requires matching message owner/login generation, loaded account preferences, current successful block-list provenance, current server/channel membership and strictly resolved ViewChannel plus ReadMessages permissions. Detached historical windows and connection loss suppress text.

Blocked, ignored, spam-filtered, undecrypted and spoiler-delimited messages are excluded. Only bounded ID, author label and literal text cross IPC; no attachments, ciphertext, reply metadata, links as actions or hidden full message objects.

Native parser enforces five rows and UTF-16 bounds, normalizes line endings, reserves physical work-area capacity above existing widgets and strips chat data from action child surfaces. Renderer reserves chat height and renders text nodes only.
Block-list provenance is invalidated synchronously on account/login-generation changes; failed or superseded list fetches cannot authorize this second message surface.
